clue.text: Controversial Caribbean plan to embrace United States under Trump's leadership?

definitions.text: Controversial Caribbean plan to embrace United States under Trump's leadership?

parts.words: Controversial Caribbean plan to embrace United States under Trump's leadership?
parts.note: a jibe that Trump is turning America into a corrupt, unstable statelet of the kind once dominated by fruit companies in Central America and the Caribbean

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads like news of a Caribbean policy towards Washington; the question mark says the country itself, under Trump, has become the thing described.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a derisive term for a politically unstable state run for the benefit of a small elite, first applied to Central American fruit-exporting countries.

clue.text: In which Bill stripped during sleazy fumble?

definitions.text: In which Bill stripped during sleazy fumble?

indicators.note: one piece sits within the time of the other, so the shorter letters go inside the rearranged ones
something sleazy is disreputable and disordered, so the letters of fumble are jumbled
the word Bill has its clothes, its outer letters, taken off

explanation.surface: A seedy encounter in which a man named Bill gets undressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stripped' takes the outer letters off Bill, and 'during' places what is left inside the rearranged letters of fumble. Read whole, the clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A pornographic movie is one in which people strip and fumble sleazily, which is what the whole clue pictures.

clue.text: I complain about Campbell

indicators.note: turning about means the letters of the pieces are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: to complain is to moan

explanation.surface: Someone grumbling about a person called Campbell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' reverses IMOAN. Campbell is the supermodel's surname, so the definition is by example.
explanation.definitionFit: The British supermodel Campbell has this first name, so the surname points to the forename.

clue.text: Born ordinary, left India mostly stupid, as from the Stone Age

parts.note: née, born, gives NE
India is I in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: most of the word but not all, so the last letter is cut off

parts.note: a stupid person is thick

explanation.surface: A dismissive description of a dim, ordinary person, compared to a caveman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts the last letter from THICK to give THIC.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes the later Stone Age, the period of polished stone tools and early farming.

clue.text: See 1
Swanky homes the length of the Atlantic seaboard

definitions.meaning: grand country houses with large grounds

definitions.text: the length of the Atlantic seaboard
definitions.meaning: read cryptically as ..., the eastern states that run all along America's Atlantic coast

explanation.surface: Luxury mansions lining the whole of America's east coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Large country properties with a big house are called this, and split as E STATES the word also names the eastern US states.

clue.text: Republican out of control in part of Jersey?

indicators.note: the letter is taken out of the longer word

parts.note: a rudder is the steering control of a boat or plane

explanation.surface: A Republican politician running wild on the island of Jersey.
explanation.walkthrough: Jersey looks like the Channel Island or New Jersey, but here it is the breed of dairy cow; the question mark flags the definition by example.
explanation.definitionFit: A Jersey is a breed of dairy cow, and this milk-producing organ is part of every cow.

clue.text: Barbie's inscription on romantic gift

definitions.meaning: what the doll Barbie might write to her boyfriend doll
a keepsake given as a sign of affection

explanation.surface: An engraving on a present between sweethearts.
explanation.walkthrough: Barbie's doll boyfriend is Ken, so her message would be 'love to Ken'.
explanation.definitionFit: A keepsake given between lovers as a sign of affection is called by this phrase.

clue.text: He has the knives out for smarter Liberal arriviste

indicators.note: a newcomer arriving among others, so the letter arrives inside the longer word

parts.note: cuter means more clever, smarter

explanation.surface: A sharper Liberal newcomer is gunning for his rivals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He has the knives out' sounds like political backstabbing, but it is literal: a knife seller.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman who makes or sells knives literally has knives laid out for sale.

clue.text: One delivering the Bible with God in spirit

indicators.note: one piece goes in another

parts.note: gin is an alcoholic spirit
Deo is Latin for God, as in Deo gratias

explanation.surface: A Bible-bearer full of godly spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spirit' looks religious but is the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of the Gideons International organisation place free Bibles in hotel rooms, so one of them delivers Bibles.

clue.text: Nervous consultant leaves Tyneside for a job in the private sector

definitions.text: a job in the private sector

indicators.note: the letters for the region depart from the specialist's title

parts.note: a hospital consultant specialising in nerves is a neurologist
Tyneside is in the North East of England, NE

explanation.surface: A specialist doctor leaves the north-east of England for private practice.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'private sector' is the private parts: this specialist treats the urinary and male reproductive organs.
explanation.definitionFit: This specialist deals with the urinary tract and genitals, the body's 'private' region, punningly a job in that sector.

clue.text: Result of Trump's weekend ground-breaking activity?

definitions.text: Result of Trump's weekend ground-breaking activity?

parts.words: Result of Trump's weekend ground-breaking activity?
parts.note: Trump spends weekends playing golf, and a bad swing breaks the ground, tearing up a piece of turf

explanation.walkthrough: 'ground-breaking' suggests innovation, but here it is literal: a golf club gouging turf.
explanation.definitionFit: A chunk of turf cut out of the ground by a golf club during a shot is called this.

clue.text: He's out exercising terrific bod!

indicators.note: exercising works the letters around into new shapes

explanation.surface: A fitness fanatic out jogging and showing off his body.
explanation.walkthrough: Topical: James Comey had just been sacked by Trump as head of the US Federal Bureau of Investigation.
explanation.definitionFit: The head of the US Bureau, Comey, had recently been fired, so the man holding that post was out.

clue.text: Supporter held up by 23

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from the bottom
the inner letters are what is held, so the outer pair around them is dropped

parts.note: 23 down is MEETS

explanation.surface: Something propped up by another clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is held inside MEETS (23 down), read 'up' from the bottom: dropping M and S leaves EET, which 'up' reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: A golf ball sits on a small peg that supports it before the drive.

clue.text: Clearly amused, handle butt

parts.note: someone obviously amused is laughing
the stock is the handle of a gun

explanation.surface: Someone visibly entertained, grabbing hold of the end of a rifle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'butt' looks like part of a gun, which 'handle' reinforces, but it means the target of ridicule.
explanation.definitionFit: The butt of a joke is the target everyone mocks, a person made an object of ridicule.

clue.text: Virgin, United in Dulles manoeuvre

indicators.note: a manoeuvre moves the letters about into new positions

explanation.surface: Airlines Virgin and United jockey for position at Dulles airport, Washington.
explanation.walkthrough: Virgin and United look like airlines, Dulles like the airport; Virgin is the definition as an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Something virgin is untouched and pure, without any stain or blemish.

clue.text: Having stirred up demons, I sought oblivion in these places

definitions.text: Having stirred up demons, I sought oblivion in these places

indicators.note: stirring mixes the letters around

explanation.surface: A troubled soul seeking escape from inner demons in a drug den.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stirred' mixes UP DEMONS I; the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Places where people went to smoke the drug and drift into a stupor, seeking oblivion, are called this.

clue.text: Where UN tomorrow hosts signature to this document

indicators.note: the words play host to the letters inside them

explanation.surface: A venue where the United Nations will hold a signing ceremony tomorrow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hosts' holds the answer across 'wHERE UN TOmorrow'; the signature sense suits 'hereunto I set my hand'.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal adverb meaning to this writing or attached to it, used in formulas like 'hereunto I set my hand'.

clue.text: Wracked with colic, Sean Spicer gives up PR for academic study

indicators.note: wracked means tormented, twisted, so the letters are thrown into disorder
the letters are surrendered from the name

parts.note: PR, public relations, taken from the name as letters

explanation.surface: Trump's press secretary, doubled up in pain, abandons his public-relations role to study.
explanation.walkthrough: Sean Spicer was Trump's press secretary. 'gives up' takes P and R from SEAN SPICER, leaving SEANSICE; 'Wracked' mixes that with COLIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Sociology, economics and politics are fields of academic study grouped under this name for the study of human society.

clue.text: Everyone takes cocaine over heroin over booze

indicators.note: the outer word takes the others inside it

parts.note: everyone is all
C is slang shorthand for cocaine
O is the cricket abbreviation for an over
H is slang shorthand for heroin
O again for over, from cricket

explanation.surface: A tale of a whole crowd's drug and drink binge.
explanation.walkthrough: In a cricket scorebook O stands for an over.
explanation.definitionFit: Booze is informal for intoxicating drink, and the spirit in it is the chemical behind the effect.

clue.text: Accelerated special edition of Pixar movie

parts.note: Up is a 2009 animated film from the Pixar studio

explanation.surface: A special DVD release of an animated film.
explanation.definitionFit: Accelerated means went faster, made to go more quickly.

clue.text: One going over Trump's head to get Washington money for basic housing?

parts.note: a joke about Trump's hair: a hairpiece sits over the head
WA is the postal abbreviation for Washington state

explanation.surface: Someone bypassing Trump to get federal funds for low-cost housing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going over Trump's head' sounds like bypassing him but is a dig at his famous hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A domed hut of poles and bark or hides, traditional among some Native American peoples, is simple shelter.

clue.text: Unwell, having taken first bit of tablet

indicators.note: the opening letter has been taken away

parts.note: a tablet is a pill

explanation.surface: Someone feeling poorly after swallowing part of a tablet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having taken' suggests swallowing medicine, but it takes away the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Unwell and this short word are plain synonyms for sick or in poor health.

clue.text: 28, my cue to direct Minnie Driver?

indicators.note: to direct is to arrange and order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: 28 across is ESKIMO

explanation.surface: A film director cueing the actress Minnie Driver.
explanation.walkthrough: Minnie Driver is a British actress, but here she is Minnie Mouse's driver, i.e. her boyfriend at the wheel.
explanation.definitionFit: Disney's famous mouse is Minnie's partner, cheekily pictured as the one driving her about.

clue.text: Encounters between Fox and Hunt facilitated by May, perhaps

definitions.text: between Fox and Hunt facilitated by May, perhaps
definitions.meaning: cabinet meetings between ministers Liam Fox and Jeremy Hunt arranged by Theresa May, with a hint of fox-hunting gatherings, which May proposed to allow a vote on

explanation.surface: Prime Minister May bringing her ministers Fox and Hunt together.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means comes face to face with, and the noun is also a gathering of a hunt before setting off.

clue.text: Having a certain taste, Knut's turned up to support Ms Thurman

indicators.note: in a down clue the lower piece holds up the one above it

parts.note: Uma Thurman is an American actress

indicators.note: in a down clue the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: the setter Knut, speaking as I am, gives IM

explanation.surface: The setter turning up as a fan of actress Uma Thurman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Knut's' is the setter's name with 's for 'is', giving I'M.
explanation.definitionFit: The savoury fifth basic flavour, alongside sweet, sour, salty and bitter, is a distinct taste.

clue.text: Grassy area where the President gets shot?

definitions.text: Grassy area where the President gets shot?

parts.words: Grassy area where the President gets shot?
parts.note: the turf outside the US leader's residence, where he is photographed, with an alarming second reading of shot

explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' looks like assassination, but it means photographed: press pictures are taken on this grass.
explanation.definitionFit: The grass in front of the US presidential residence is where press photographs and ceremonies happen.

clue.text: See 25
Fashion model entertained by Stallone, with discretion

parts.note: fashion is mode

indicators.note: the letter is entertained, taken in, by the name

parts.note: Sly is actor Sylvester Stallone's nickname
the Model T was Ford's famous car

explanation.surface: A fashion model dining out with Sylvester Stallone, keeping it quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'model' looks like the fashion model, but it is the Ford Model T, giving T.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting with discretion means behaving unassumingly and without show, in a restrained way.

clue.text: One with cold hands inside Kellyanne's kimono?

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words

explanation.surface: Kellyanne Conway's chilly hands tucked inside her kimono.
explanation.walkthrough: Kellyanne Conway was a Trump adviser.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from the Arctic peoples of the far north lives in bitter cold, so would have cold hands.
